# The Washington Post

> > Award-winning journalism covering national politics, world news, sports, health, and opinion from one of America's leading newspapers.

The Washington Post delivers comprehensive news coverage with a strong focus on political analysis, international affairs including the Russia-Ukraine war, and extensive sports reporting on teams like the Capitals, Nationals, and Commanders. The publication features investigative journalism, expert commentary, and specialized newsletters for policy professionals.

## Key Topics

- Trump
- Iran
- Politics & Elections
- Russia-Ukraine War
- European Union
- College Basketball & March Madness
- Formula 1
- NBA & Professional Sports
- Healthcare & Medical Research
- Washington D.C. Politics
- Midterm Elections
- SEC Tournament
- Alpine Skiing
- Gymnastics
- Political Commentary

## Politics & Analysis

- [The Briefs - The Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/the-briefs-newsletters/): Political newsletter guides for D.C. decision-makers on elections & policy

## Opinion & Commentary

- [Washington Post Opinions - The Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/): Opinion articles, editorials, op-eds & political commentary by experts

## Sports Coverage

- [Sports - The Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/): Sports news covering Capitals, Nationals, Commanders, college & pro teams

## World News

- [Europe - The Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/): European news covering Russia-Ukraine war, EU politics & international affairs

## Health & Wellness

- [Health - The Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/): Health news covering healthcare, medical research, drugs & fitness topics
